requirements.label: Hip pitch peak torque
requirements.derived_from: max |actuator force| over both hip_pitch joints and all steps, traced nominal rollout of the witness (traj_100.json); 874 steps of 2 ms. SATURATED: equals the model's actuator limit (88 N*m), so the unconstrained demand is at least this value

requirements.label: Hip pitch peak joint speed
requirements.derived_from: max |joint velocity| over both hip_pitch joints and all steps, traced nominal rollout of the witness (traj_100.json); 874 steps of 2 ms

requirements.label: Hip roll peak torque
requirements.derived_from: max |actuator force| over both hip_roll joints and all steps, traced nominal rollout of the witness (traj_100.json); 874 steps of 2 ms

requirements.label: Hip roll peak joint speed
requirements.derived_from: max |joint velocity| over both hip_roll joints and all steps, traced nominal rollout of the witness (traj_100.json); 874 steps of 2 ms

requirements.label: Hip yaw peak torque

requirements.label: Hip yaw peak joint speed

requirements.label: Knee peak torque
requirements.derived_from: max |actuator force| over both knee joints and all steps, traced nominal rollout of the witness (traj_100.json); 874 steps of 2 ms. SATURATED: equals the model's actuator limit (139 N*m), so the unconstrained demand is at least this value

requirements.label: Knee peak joint speed
requirements.derived_from: max |joint velocity| over both knee joints and all steps, traced nominal rollout of the witness (traj_100.json); 874 steps of 2 ms

requirements.label: Ankle pitch peak torque
requirements.derived_from: max |actuator force| over both ankle_pitch joints and all steps, traced nominal rollout of the witness (traj_100.json); 874 steps of 2 ms. SATURATED: equals the model's actuator limit (50 N*m), so the unconstrained demand is at least this value

requirements.label: Ankle pitch peak joint speed
requirements.derived_from: max |joint velocity| over both ankle_pitch joints and all steps, traced nominal rollout of the witness (traj_100.json); 874 steps of 2 ms

requirements.label: Ankle roll peak torque
requirements.derived_from: max |actuator force| over both ankle_roll joints and all steps, traced nominal rollout of the witness (traj_100.json); 874 steps of 2 ms

requirements.label: Ankle roll peak joint speed
requirements.derived_from: max |joint velocity| over both ankle_roll joints and all steps, traced nominal rollout of the witness (traj_100.json); 874 steps of 2 ms

requirements.label: Peak total mechanical power (12 leg joints)
requirements.derived_from: max over steps of sum(max(tau*qdot, 0)), traced nominal rollout of the witness (traj_100.json); 874 steps of 2 ms

requirements.label: Mechanical energy per jump (to liftoff)
requirements.derived_from: integral of positive joint power from start to liftoff (t = 0.72 s), traced nominal rollout of the witness (traj_100.json); 874 steps of 2 ms

requirements.label: Peak landing ground-reaction force
requirements.derived_from: peak vertical foot contact force after first touchdown, traced nominal rollout of the witness (traj_100.json); 874 steps of 2 ms

requirements.label: Battery energy for 100 jumps
requirements.derived_from: jump energy x 100 / drive efficiency 0.5 (default, unverified); excludes standby and walking

risks.text: Joint speed is compared with the vendor no-load speed, which overstates speed at peak torque.
risks.physical_test: Dynamometer test of the chosen actuator at the jump's torque-speed point.
risks.tied_to: no torque-speed curves read from vendors

risks.text: Thermal limits: peak torque is a short-duration vendor figure; repeated jumps heat the motors.
risks.physical_test: Repeated-jump thermal soak test with motor temperature logging.

risks.text: The landing GRF limit is an unverified default (no hardware source).
risks.physical_test: Drop test of the leg assembly instrumented with a force plate.

risks.text: Structural strength of links/mounts is a hand calculation only.
risks.physical_test: FEA + proof load of the shank link.

risks.text: Sensing and actuator latency are not modelled (perfect state feedback).
risks.physical_test: Hardware-in-the-loop test with real encoder/command latency.

risks.text: Mass of the selected actuators is added on top of the G1 model mass (no sourced per-joint G1 actuator mass to subtract); the battery mass is a placeholder.
risks.physical_test: Weigh the real assembly and re-run the loop.

labels: Structural strength not analyzed (no FEA) - simplified model, needs precise validation
Perfect state feedback assumed; real sensing/latency not modeled - simplified model, needs precise validation
Landing GRF limit is an unverified default, not a hardware figure

The G1 model's own link masses already include its motors; the sourced catalog gives no per-joint G1 actuator mass to subtract, so the designed actuators/links are added ON TOP of robot_mass (upper bound on the mass effect).
Joint speed compared with vendor no-load speed (optimistic at peak torque); no torque-speed curves.
Closed-loop re-runs use the recorded bundle's search/Monte-Carlo budget and seed; each re-run is one seeded sample (finite-budget search noise applies).
